gold.general: Ground truth / gold-standard target response. A reference label determined independently of the tested model prediction, by source facts and a prespecified policy oracle where reliable.
gold.dataset_annotation: Human or source-provided label; may contain annotator error or insufficient visible evidence; is not automatically independent verification.
gold.native_rule_oracle: Policy computed directly from valid observed source-native state; independent implementation should verify Gold vs corpus annotation, ambiguity flagged; does not prove deployment authorization.
gold.deployed_authorization: True user permission, source authority, actual action arguments and side effects; not present in currently verified SecJev Twins/LANL evaluation.

twins.rule: Conflict flag has priority; reject_conflict if valid conflict, else accept if distinct eligible candidate authors meet quorum, else wait.

lanl.rule: If within-window prior failures>=5 or failed destinations>=3 then investigate. Otherwise record_failed_attempt for current failed LogOn, continue_monitoring for current success.

example.original_gold: record_failed_attempt (if current failed LogOn); otherwise continue_monitoring

gold.gold_status: Gold available for original rows; modified paired states have not been independently validated. Gold is a reference for scoring predictions, not the model's probability or its choice.

budget_protocol_name_collision.mismatch: SOP G0 = CPU-only preflight; protocol field stage_g0_max_native_forwards appears under future_gpu_if_admitted and MUST NOT be read as G0 GPU permission. Interpret only as hypothetical pilot-forward cap after actual G0 passes.
budget_protocol_name_collision.resolution_without_overwriting_old_propo: In any newly registered protocol after valid G-1 use PILOT_NATIVE_G1_BUDGET and MECHANISM_HOOK_SEPARATE_BUDGET nomenclature, with independent approvals.

next_valid_work: Complete G-1 novelty review in preregistered file before any new revision of experimental protocol, then CPU-only source-native row edit and independent old/new Gold verification for 31/22 candidate seeds; freeze controls and hashes before any pilot GPU approval.
